Hi! From the design review on delivery_rings: the list ends with the last non-empty ring — when every reachable depot is closer than max_hops, no trailing empty rings are added (a depot without roads therefore gives []). Hope that helps!

Review of find_cycle (request_changes): Two acceptance failures. (1) test_no_cycle: find_cycle([('A','A',1),('A','B',2)]) returns ['A','A'] but expects None — the self-loop is being treated as a cycle; the docstring says self-loops are ignored but the DFS still closes on v==u. (2) test_regression_issue_250 expects ['A','B'] (open) for [('A','B',1),('B','A',1)] while test_cycles expects ['A','B','A'] (closed) for the identical input — these two tests are mutually exclusive, likely a bad migration import; flag with qa-team. Please fix the self-loop handling and resolve the open-vs-closed contradiction before merging.
